parsedVerdict.reasoning: The core work of the use case belongs in the application layer. It loads products through the domain ProductRepository port and maps them to DTOs. However, `ListStockLevelsUseCase.execute(request?: Request)` makes an Express HTTP `Request` part of the use case's contract. Handling the HTTP request object is a job for the transport/presentation layer, which sits in infrastructure in this layer model. An application service should receive plain input such as DTOs or primitives, not framework request objects. The parameter is unused and is also missing from the `ListStockLevels` interface, so the only effect is to tie the use case's public API to the web framework. Whether the import itself is allowed is out of scope. The finding is about the method contract: the use case is set up to take a transport object. Confidence is moderate because the method does no actual request handling.
